operation.name: CreateNonGBVMain_ELRP
operation.query:
IF (EXISTS (SELECT NonGBVMainID FROM [NonGBVMain_ELRP] WHERE Deleted = 0 AND SerialNumber=@SerialNumber )) SET @ReturnValue = 0 ELSE BEGIN
INSERT INTO [NonGBVMain_ELRP] ([Date] ,[StateID] ,[CountyID] ,[PayamID] ,[BomaID] ,[DateOfComplaint] ,[ReportingChannel] ,[ReportingChannelOther] ,[ComplainantName] ,[ContactNumber] ,[PhysicalAddress] ,[Gender] ,[Age] ,[SSSNPBeneficiary] ,[TypeOfGrievanceID] ,[TypeOfGrievanceDetailID] ,[TypeOfGrievanceOther] ,[Status] ,[StatusLastModificationDate] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID] ,[DescriptionCompliant] ,[DescriptionCompliantAttachmentID] ,[TypeOfComplaintID] ,[Deleted]) VALUES (@Date ,@StateID ,@CountyID ,@PayamID ,@BomaID ,@DateOfComplaint ,@ReportingChannel ,@ReportingChannelOther ,@ComplainantName ,@ContactNumber ,@PhysicalAddress ,@Gender ,@Age ,@SSSNPBeneficiary ,@TypeOfGrievanceID ,@TypeOfGrievanceDetailID ,@TypeOfGrievanceOther ,@Status ,@StatusLastModificationDate ,@CreationUserID ,@LastModificationTimestamp ,@LastModificationUserID ,@DescriptionCompliant ,@DescriptionCompliantAttachmentID ,@TypeOfComplaintID ,0) SET @ReturnValue = SCOPE_IDENTITY() END

operation.name: UpdateNonGBVMain_ELRP
operation.query:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT NonGBVMainID FROM [NonGBVMain_ELRP] WHERE Deleted = 0 AND NonGBVMainID = @NonGBVMainID )) SET @ReturnValue = 0 ELSE BEGIN UPDATE [NonGBVMain_ELRP] SET -- [Date] = @Date -- ,[SerialNumber] = @SerialNumber [StateID] = @StateID ,[CountyID] = @CountyID ,[PayamID] = @PayamID ,[BomaID] = @BomaID ,[DateOfComplaint] = @DateOfComplaint ,[ReportingChannel] = @ReportingChannel ,[ReportingChannelOther] = @ReportingChannelOther ,[ComplainantName] = @ComplainantName ,[ContactNumber] = @ContactNumber ,[PhysicalAddress] = @PhysicalAddress ,[Gender] = @Gender ,[Age] = @Age ,[SSSNPBeneficiary] = @SSSNPBeneficiary ,[TypeOfGrievanceID] = @TypeOfGrievanceID ,[TypeOfGrievanceDetailID] = @TypeOfGrievanceDetailID ,[TypeOfGrievanceOther] = @TypeOfGrievanceOther ,[Status] = @Status ,[StatusLastModificationDate] = @StatusLastModificationDate ,[LastModificationTimestamp] = @LastModificationTimestamp ,[LastModificationUserID] = @LastModificationUserID ,[DescriptionCompliant] = @DescriptionCompliant ,[DescriptionCompliantAttachmentID] = @DescriptionCompliantAttachmentID ,[TypeOfComplaintID] =@TypeOfComplaintID WHERE Deleted = 0 and NonGBVMainID = @NonGBVMainID
SET @ReturnValue = 1
END

operation.name: GetNonGBVMain_ELRP
operation.query: SELECT [NonGBVMainID] ,[Date] ,[SerialNumber] ,[StateID] ,[CountyID] ,[PayamID] ,[BomaID] ,[DateOfComplaint] ,[ReportingChannel] ,[ReportingChannelOther] ,[ComplainantName] ,[ContactNumber] ,[PhysicalAddress] ,[Gender] ,[Age] ,[SSSNPBeneficiary] ,[TypeOfGrievanceID] ,[TypeOfGrievanceDetailID] ,[TypeOfGrievanceOther] ,[Status] ,[StatusLastModificationDate] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID] ,[DescriptionCompliant] ,[DescriptionCompliantAttachmentID] ,[TypeOfComplaintID] FROM [NonGBVMain_ELRP] WHERE Deleted =0 AND NonGBVMainID = @NonGBVMainID

operation.name: DeleteNonGBVMain_ELRP
operation.query:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT NonGBVMainID FROM [NonGBVMain_ELRP] WHERE Deleted = 0 AND NonGBVMainID = @NonGBVMainID )) SET @ReturnValue = 0 ELSE BEGIN
UPDATE [NonGBVMain_ELRP] SET [LastModificationTimestamp] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @UserID ,[Deleted] = 1 WHERE NonGBVMainID = @NonGBVMainID
SET @ReturnValue = 1
END

operation.name: UpdateNonGBVStatus_ELRP
operation.query: UPDATE [NonGBVMain_ELRP] SET [Status] = @Status ,[StatusLastModificationDate] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationTimestamp] = getdate() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @userID WHERE NonGBVMainID = @NonGBVMainID and Deleted = 0 set @ReturnValue = 1

operation.name: GetNonGBVMainIDByDetailID_ELRP
operation.query:
set @ReturnValue = (SELECT top 1 m.NonGBVMainID
FROM [NonGBVMain_ELRP] as M left join NonGBVDetails_elrp as d on (d.NonGBVMainID = m.NonGBVMainID and d.Deleted = 0) where d.Deleted = 0 and d.NonGBVDetailID = @NonGBVDetailID)
